name: Auto Thumbnail Generator
author: netfox it solutions

sections.description:
This plugin automatically generates a featured image for your posts if none is provided. It uses the post title text with customizable background color, font color, and font size.

Features

  • Auto-generate featured image with post title.
  • Updates image when post is updated.
  • Customize background color, font size, and font color.
  • Lightweight and fast.

Credits

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Configure settings under Settings → Auto Thumbnails.
sections.faq:
Will it overwrite my existing thumbnails?

No, it only works when no thumbnail is set, or when updating an auto-generated one.

Can I change the colors?

Yes, you can set background and font colors in the settings.
